Step:  
1451 is not a leap year (divisible by 3, not by 4).  
11-07-1451 = July 11, 1451.  
76 days earlier:  
Back 11 days → June 30, 1451.  
Back another 65 days: June has 30 days, so back 30 days → May 31.  
Remaining 35 days: back 31 days → May 1.  
Remaining 4 days: back 4 days → April 27, 1451.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1451-04-27
